provenance.membership_authority: Disciplinare DOC «Verduno Pelaverga o Verduno», Art. 3
provenance.note: Entire comune of Verduno PLUS part of La Morra and Roddi. Tiny appellation. Footprint = Verduno only (whole); La Morra/Roddi are partial and EXCLUDED from the footprint (ISTAT has no sub-comune geometry, and unioning the whole of either would grossly over-approximate) — documented under-approximation, same treatment as Barbaresco's Alba frazione. ISTAT dissolve, hole-free.
